info.title: SCP:CB - Wii U Edition
info.author: NanoBunTV
info.description: A native port of SCP Containment Breach
info.details:
A native port of SCP - Containment Breach (v1.3.11) to the Wii U, for the Aroma homebrew environment.

Everything is included. SCP - Containment Breach is free and licensed under Creative Commons, so the game's files come with the port. You don't need anything else.

For full features list and controls, check out the GitHub: github.com/NanoBunTV/Wii-U-SCPCB

Disclosure: AI was used to assist in development.
